scripts.build:wordlist: d=$(mktemp -d) && tsc --ignoreConfig --outDir "$d" --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --strict --skipLibCheck --types node scripts/build-prediction-word-list.ts && echo '{"type":"module"}' > "$d/package.json" && node "$d/scripts/build-prediction-word-list.js" "$PWD"; s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $s
